messages:
anya: quick idea - can we add a preview/dry-run mode for priority-routing configs so PMs can see effects without touching traffic?
sam: yes pls. two flavors imo: dry-run (telemetry only) and shadow (duplicate traffic). dry-run = no backend hit. shadow = real hit + duplicate to analysis.
morgan: API question: expose separate endpoint /configs/preview or extend POST /configs with effect param? i prefer single endpoint with `effect` so tooling has one contract.
kevin: ops: caveat re quotas & billing. even telemetry-only could cause cost estimates if we simulate. need a clear marker so billing ignores dry-run by default.
riley: console: preview should show sample decisions (anonymized hashing), estimated token cost, and a toggle for "simulate quota impact". mock: https://figma/r/preview-prio-route
anya: proposed payload:
```
{
  "flag": "routing.priority.v3",
  "effect": "dryrun",   // dryrun | shadow | apply
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "targets": ["cohort:beta"],
  "simulate_quota": false
}
```
sam: telemetry signals to collect during preview: route.win_rate, route.miss_rate, backend.latency_p95, quota.simulated_exhaustion, cost.estimate_per_min. default delta thresholds: miss_rate +3% absolute, latency_p95 +15% relative.
morgan: add `preview_id` UUID returned by API and tag all metrics with it. also add /configs/validate that returns estimated metrics without creating a preview instance.
kevin: safety: shadow should be opt-in and capped server-side. propose server field `shadow_max_qps` and default 0 (disabled). require admins to enable. also require explicit `simulate_quota=true` + admin to simulate quota.
riley: UX: diff view showing "before vs after" routing table (sample rows). make sure we reuse prefix cache for quick previews. include a small matrix of alert risk (low/med/high) based on delta thresholds.
anya: automation: if a canary preview shows delta above thresholds, auto-mark preview as failed and notify the config owner. we shouldn't auto-revert since nothing applied, but should block promotion.
sam: ops runbook snippet: when running preview, use tag runmode=dryrun and preview_id=<id>. Dashboards should support `exclude runmode=dryrun` when calculating production SLAs.
morgan: open question: should dryrun produce synthetic quota.decrement events in telemetry? i'd prefer no by default but an explicit flag to generate them for cost-modeling.
kevin: agreed. server behaviour: dryrun default simulate_quota=false. if simulate_quota=true require admin token and log audit entry.
riley: will add toggle in console and a tiny explanation tooltip. PTAL figma.
anya: owners: kevin (server + caps), morgan (api + validate), riley (console + figma), sam (telemetry + alerts). i'll schedule a 30min sync post PRs.
canary-bot: preview-runner: started dryrun preview routing.priority.v3 for cohort:beta, sample 50k hashes, preview_id=8f9b6a2c.
kevin: PR incoming today, will include `shadow_max_qps` and admin checks.
morgan: drafting swagger now with examples for dryrun, shadow, validate.
sam: I'll draft alerting playbook and dashboard filters. add example queries to exclude runmode=dryrun.
riley: small note: when showing sample hashed rows, do not show real customer ids. show truncated hash + sample rationale.
anya: perfect. thanks team! excited to get safer routing experiments in place. :rocket:
